notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Tradewind Rider does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Wormfang Manta, and one other creature, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
